# asc_subnet (Data Source)

Reads a subnet belonging to an ASC VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing subnet by its VPC name and subnet name.
data "asc_subnet" "public" {
  vpc_name = "platform"
  name     = "public"
}

output "public_subnet_cidr" {
  value = data.asc_subnet.public.cidr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the subnet to read.
- `vpc_name` (String) Name of the VPC that owns the subnet.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) CIDR block of the subnet.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the subnet.
- `last_error` (String) Last error reported for the subnet, empty when healthy.
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle status.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the subnet.
- `urn` (String) URN of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (String) Identifier of the owning VPC.
